verify.note: Closed 2026-09-29 (ADR-1665). Imports the real lib/analytics/outcomes.ts and runs getOutcomeReport against a stand-in admin client holding fixture rows for journey_enrollments, journey_completions, journey_plans and journey_lesson_progress. The Journeys section must list each taken Journey with distinct takers and finishers (a repeat take or a second-season finish counts once, a member who finished and left still counts as a taker), the stall step must average lessons checked plus one over the unfinished, and a Journey with 1,200 takes must read all 1,200 past the 1,000-row page. Fails on main at the first arm (no per-Journey rollup exists). Each arm was mutation-fired. Exits 79 only when the file is gone.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1665). WHY IT WAS EMPTY: not a query, a join or a status value. getOutcomeReport never read anything for Journeys: it assigned quests = [] after the legacy quest_outcomes() RPC was retired with the action-chain engine (ADR-152 Phase B3), and the follow-up the header promised never landed. NO STATUS FILTER: journey_enrollments and journey_completions carry no status column (supabase/migrations/20260621000000_journeys_v2.sql, 20260628010000_quest_completion_model.sql); a finish is the existence of a journey_completions row, written only by lib/quest/complete.ts. THE ROW ASKED FOR qualifying weeks at or above target_weeks from practice_logs. That derivation is retired (lib/journeys/progress.ts calls itself its replacement; completion is now 14 distinct in-window practice days plus the Expression Challenge, lib/quest/completion.ts), so rebuilding it would report a bar no member is held to. The code wins: completion is the canonical journey_completions row. WHAT SHIPS: lib/analytics/outcomes.ts computeJourneyOutcomes (pure) rolls up per Journey the distinct members who took it (journey_enrollments, plus anyone with a finish), the distinct members who finished it (journey_completions, any season), the rate, and the stall step (lessons checked off in journey_lesson_progress plus one, averaged over the unfinished). getOutcomeReport reads the four tables a page at a time (1,000-row PostgREST cap) and fills the section; the admin Insights Outcomes tab keys rows by plan id. No migration. TESTS: lib/analytics/outcomes.test.ts, fixture rows for all four tables, including a 1,500-take page run.
